summary: SK hynix filed a Form 6-K responding to a Korea Exchange disclosure inquiry into media reports that it is pursuing the sale of an ownership stake in its Chongqing, China packaging plant, reported valued at approximately KRW 4 trillion. The company stated it is reviewing various measures to strengthen packaging-business competitiveness but no matters have been determined. It will disclose further details when confirmed or within three months of this September 9, 2026 report. No buyer, stake percentage, price per share, premium, advisor, or board recommendation was named. Watch for a definitive stake-sale announcement and potential overhang on earnings.
